name: Southernmost Solving 2023

venue.name: James Hargest College
venue.address: James Hargest College Senior Campus, 288 Layard Street, Hargest, Invercargill 9810

information: Southernmost Solving 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
